blocks.text: Christmas shopping often comes with the challenge of finding a gift that feels personal to the recipient. This 2026 holiday season, SM City Cebu brings together fashion and lifestyle choices from Charles & Keith, Coach, Victoria’s Secret, and Karimadon, giving Cebuano shoppers more options for finding presents that suit the different styles, interests, and needs of the women in their lives. Rather than settling for one-size-fits-all presents, shoppers can explore pieces that reflect how women dress, accessorize, and care for themselves. The selection also puts the focus on gifts that can become part of everyday routines or be saved for special […]...
